verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Workers deployment, bindings, AI, agents, and API tokens, but never mentions Cloudflare's SaaS custom-hostname/domain provisioning capability (e.g. Cloudflare for SaaS, Custom Hostnames API) needed to programmatically route custom domains for multi-tenant SaaS customers. Universal SSL (cloudflare-docs-13) only covers domains added directly to a Cloudflare zone, not tenant-provided custom domains routed to a SaaS app. Since this is a plausible and common ask for a platform with DNS/SSL/Workers capabilities, absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
